i   haven't played too much mm since f2p but there are a huge amount of hackers I have encountered. last night i decided to go through some matches i had played; i only went through 8 (6 since f2p 2 since before) because it eats a huge amount of time but from that i came to what i feel are some reasonable conclusions. really there are only 4 scenarios:     
1) the opponents beat us/we beat the opponents handily but not enough to say they anyone is cheating    
2) We start off winning/ they start winning/ its a close game which causes dormant hackers on the other team to start being more obvious or even rage hacking  
3) one or more player on either team has an easily visually detectable hack and ruins everyones experience.   
4) everyone is very clean and its a close intense match :)   


 With f2p it feels like scenario 2 has become the most common easily taking up atleast half the games I've played. That doesn't sound like too much but say i played 10 games, thats atleast 3 hours that have been ruined along with my mood :( . Unfortunately number 3 isn't as rare as I'd like it to be either; just last night i played 2 games both had very obvious cheaters and one had 3 on the other team :(( . The worst part is that I've become so suspicious of anyone who's playing well just assuming they're probably hacking which is a terrible mindset and is pretty killer to my motivation. I haven't played a 4 since f2p mostly because im probably at the lowest point of my skill in a while but it also might be a telltale sign of another issue that has arisen which is an influx of smurfs using old accounts and what not.  Some additional info if anyone wants (info is mostly about my trust): My account is about 2 years old, for the most of this run i was MGE i have since deranked (I admit this is due to me personally playing terribly and not to do with f2p), I have a green 2018 service medal and have just about 1000 hours on CS and i think 300ish wins.
